overview.text: The Tiger Keelback (Yamakagashi) is a venomous snake of East Asia. It is also poisonous: glands in its neck store toxins taken from the toads it eats.

identification.text: Olive-green with black and bright orange bars or spots on the front third of the body; whitish belly.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: The Russian Far East, Korea, much of China, Taiwan, Vietnam and Japan.

diet.text: Mainly frogs and toads, found by smell and sight.

behaviour.text: Two rows of glands in its neck hold toad poisons that protect it from predators.

funfacts.text: It recycles the poison of the toads it eats to protect itself.

recognise.text: Olive-green with orange and black bars near the head.
